panel.withheldBody: These minutes have been drawn up but nobody has signed them yet. A draft stays with the people who can act on it; you will be able to read it here once the host or the secretary signs it.
panel.emptyBody: The minutes are drafted from the meeting's own record — attendees, absences and the times it opened and closed come straight from the room data, and the body comes from the summary. You review and sign; the system does not sign for you.
panel.onlyChairCanDraft: Only the meeting chair can draft the minutes.
panel.documentStatusDraft: Draft — not signed and not approved
panel.documentStatusInReview: Signed by the secretary — not yet approved by the chair

toolbar.readingTitle: Read this record in another language
toolbar.bilingualFile: File with the original beside it

editing.unsavedHint: Unsaved changes. Timestamps stay attached to their line.
editing.clickToEditHint: Click any line with a dashed rule in the document below to edit it.

shareDialog.title: Share these minutes
shareDialog.description: A link opens this document — the minutes and nothing else. It carries no access to the transcript, the recording or the meeting itself.
shareDialog.modeRestrictedDetail: They sign in, and the address alone is not enough.
shareDialog.modePublicDetail: No account needed. Anyone who is sent the address can read and keep the document.
shareDialog.publicWarning: This document is public to anyone holding the address. Revoking stops future reads, but not a copy somebody already took — sharing it is your call to make.
shareDialog.draftWarning: These minutes are still a draft, so the link does not open for anyone yet — a draft is a machine's first version and nobody has signed it. Sign the document and the same address starts working; you do not have to share it again.
shareDialog.linkRevokedHint: The address that was sent no longer opens anything. Choosing a mode above issues a new one — the old address stays dead.
shareDialog.copyFallback: Copy the address from the field above.
shareDialog.letReadersDownloadHint: Off removes the button. It does not stop somebody copying what they can read.
shareDialog.nobodyAdded: Nobody has been added yet. The people who were at the meeting can already read this document.
shareDialog.modeChangeFailed: Could not change who can open this.

toasts.draftFailed: Could not draft the minutes. Has the meeting ended?
toasts.pdfUnavailable: PDF conversion is unavailable here. The Word file still downloads.
toasts.translationFailed: Could not read this record in that language.
toasts.translationNotArrived: That reading has not arrived. Try again.
toasts.translationUnavailableFallback: This reading is not available in that language.

assignedWork.heading: Assigned work
assignedWork.notPartOfRecord: Not part of the record — tracked below so follow-ups stay visible without changing a signed document.

document.heading: Minutes of meeting
document.retentionNotice: This meeting was transcribed. Retained until {date}.
document.guestNotice: One participant attended as a guest — not a workspace member.
document.untranslatedNotice: This section has not been translated into {language} yet.
